items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Vernon Brown, but the interviewee (Monk Montgomery) does not respond or provide any personal anecdote or connection regarding him.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. So now, the guys would come there and play, like Chauncey Locke and -- what's the guy's name, the drummer, Brown? Something like that...

Vernon Brown. I used to love Vernon Brown. Floyd Standifer. The players that were reaching for notes, reaching for some bebop, reaching for...You know, Miles Davis and Dizzy Gillespie and all that music.
